test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is responsible for providing safe, efficient air traffic and aeronautical communication services in the Indian air space?

options.text: Airports and Aeronautical Authority of India

solution:
Correct answer is __**Airports Authority of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)** is the regulatory body in the field of Civil Aviation, primarily dealing with safety issues.
 
• It is in **charge of regulation of air transport services** of India.
 
• The first Indian airline, **Tata Sons Ltd**., began a regular airmail service between Karachi and Madras without any patronage from the **government in 1915.**
 
• ** 'Air India'** came into being when **Tata Airlines changed its name to Air India in 1946. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The** Airports Authority of India, or AAI,** is a statutory body, under the ownership of the **Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India.**​
 
• It is responsible for creating, upgrading, maintaining, and managing civil aviation infrastructure in India. 
 
• AAI manages a total of **137 airports** which include **24 International airports (3 Civil Enclaves), 10 Customs Airports (4 Civil Enclaves), and 103 Domestic airports (23 Civil Enclaves)**.
